installation.chatScriptBody: One line of script, no other changes to your site — paste it right before the closing body tag. Never done this before? See below how to do it depending on where your site was built:
installation.wordpressStep1: In the WordPress menu, install the free plugin Insert Headers and Footers (Plugins → Add New → search by name).
installation.wordpressStep2: Once activated, go to Settings → Insert Headers and Footers.
installation.wordpressStep3: Paste the script in the "Scripts in Footer" field and click Save.
installation.wixStep1: In the Wix editor, go to Settings → Custom Code.
installation.wixStep2: Click "Add Custom Code" and paste the script.
installation.wixStep3: Under "Add Code to Pages", choose All Pages, and under "Place Code in", choose Body - end.
installation.wixNote: Custom Code is only available on paid Wix plans — on the free plan, ask for help via the contact below.
installation.agencySummary: My site was built by an agency or freelancer
installation.agencyBody: Forward the script above to whoever maintains your site and ask them to paste it right before the closing body tag — it's an instruction any developer recognizes instantly, usually takes less than 5 minutes.
installation.googleSitesSummary: My site is on Google Sites, or I don't know where to paste it
installation.googleSitesBody: Google Sites doesn't allow pasting custom scripts — in that case, use the Direct WhatsApp link or the WhatsApp button at the top of this page, which work anywhere (Google Sites, Instagram, WhatsApp, wherever you can paste a link). If you'd rather, email suporte@zappigo.com.br and we'll help you install it.
installation.domainsBody: One domain per line (e.g. mysite.com), without https:// or www. — either format is accepted automatically. While this list is empty, the script works on any site (handy for testing); once you add at least one domain, only those (plus this preview page) can use the chat as your company.

items.question: What is Zappigo?
items.answer: Zappigo is an AI scheduling, support, and customer service platform that talks to your customers on your site and on WhatsApp, books appointments automatically, and answers questions using your company's FAQ — with someone on your team able to take over the conversation at any time.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answerFree: Nothing! We're in our launch period and Zappigo is free for everyone, including the chat widget for your site and a shared WhatsApp number. No card, no catch.
items.answerPaid: The Basic plan costs {priceBasico}/month and already includes the chat widget for your site and a shared Zappigo WhatsApp number. If you want a WhatsApp number exclusive to your business, the plan costs {priceWhatsapp}/month; to connect to a scheduling system you already use, it's {priceIntegracao}/month. Each plan includes everything in Basic. Every plan has a 7-day free trial.

items.question: How does automatic scheduling work?
items.answer: You register your services (name, duration, price) in the dashboard, and the bot checks open time slots and confirms the appointment directly with the customer, respecting your business hours — with nobody on your team having to type anything.

items.question: How does WhatsApp support work?
items.answer: Every company that subscribes to Zappigo gets access to a shared WhatsApp number — the same bot that serves your site also serves customers there, automatically identifying which company the customer wants to talk to.

items.question: What if the bot doesn't know the answer?
items.answer: The bot automatically forwards the conversation to a human agent, and it shows up in your dashboard's Inbox tab for someone on your team to answer.

items.question: How do I install it on my site?
items.answer: After subscribing, you paste a single <script> line into your site, nothing else to change, and the chat shows up working right away.

items.question: Is Zappigo a WhatsApp scheduling system?
items.answer: Yes — that's exactly what it is: an AI-powered WhatsApp scheduling system. You don't need to register your own business number to get started (which usually takes days or weeks of approval on other platforms) — Zappigo already comes with a shared WhatsApp number ready to use.

sections.title: 1. Parties and acceptance
sections.body:
These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern the use of the Zappigo platform ("Zappigo", "we") by you ("Customer"). Questions about these Terms: suporte@zappigo.com.br.

You represent that you have the legal authority to enter into this agreement on behalf of the company you're registering.

Any such change will be communicated to the Customer at least 30 (thirty) days in advance, by registered email and/or notice on the dashboard itself, before it takes effect.

If Zappigo begins charging for use, the prices in effect at the time will be available at zappigo.com.br/#precos. Customers already active keep the price in effect on the date billing starts applying to them until the end of the current cycle — any later adjustment follows the 30-day advance notice below, never retroactively. The Customer may choose not to move to a paid plan, in which case access may be suspended at the end of the notice period above. Once active, paid plans may be adjusted with at least 30 days' advance notice, applicable from the next billing cycle onward; failure to pay an invoice may result in access being suspended until the account is brought current.

Copying, modifying, reverse engineering, decompiling, sublicensing, or reselling the platform (including under a white-label model) without Zappigo's express written authorization is prohibited.

You agree not to use Zappigo to:

  • send spam or illegal, discriminatory content, or content that violates third-party rights;

  • use Zappigo's shared WhatsApp number for purposes other than supporting your own customers;
  • send messages to end customers who haven't consented to receive them through that channel;
  • overload or attempt to compromise the platform's infrastructure.

LGPD compliance. The Customer is responsible for having its own legal basis to process its end customers' data and for complying with the LGPD in its relationship with them, to the extent Zappigo acts as a data processor for that data (see Privacy Policy, section 2).

Transparency about AI. The Customer is responsible for not misleading its end customers about the fact that they're talking to an automated assistant, when directly asked about it.

Shared WhatsApp number. While the Customer is on the plan that uses Zappigo's shared WhatsApp number, it's responsible for obtaining prior consent from its own end customers to be contacted through that channel, as required by Meta's commercial policies. Spam reports, blocking, or banning of the number caused by one Customer's conduct may affect the channel's availability for the others — Zappigo is not liable for unavailability arising from third-party action (Meta) triggered by any Customer's misuse, and that Customer is liable for damages caused to the others in that scenario.

Reasonable use limit. To make the free offering viable and contain AI processing costs, we apply a monthly cap on automated messages per Customer (currently 500 end-customer messages/month, adjustable at our discretion). Once the cap is reached, new conversations for the current month are routed directly to human support instead of continuing to be processed by AI. Customers needing a higher volume can request a custom limit through the contact listed in section 1.

sections.title: 1. Controller identification
sections.body: Zappigo processes personal data as described in this Policy, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018). Given the operation's current size, we don't maintain a dedicated formal Data Protection Officer (DPO) — the contact below fills that role and is the channel for exercising rights and asking questions about this Policy: suporte@zappigo.com.br.

sections.title: 2. Dual nature of the processing: controller and processor
sections.body:
Zappigo plays two different roles, depending on whose data is involved:

As controller, with respect to the data of the Customer company itself and its users (whoever creates and uses the dashboard account) — collected to provide the directly contracted service.

As processor, with respect to the data of the Customer's end customers (people who chat with the virtual assistant) — this data is collected on the Customer's behalf, and the Customer is the controller toward its own customers; Zappigo processes it strictly following the instructions and purposes set by the Customer.

sections.title: 3. Data processed and purposes
sections.body:
Of the Customer company and its users: name, email, phone (optional), password (stored encrypted), and payment data — processed directly by Stripe; Zappigo never stores card numbers. Used to create and maintain your account, process charges (where applicable), and provide support.

Of the Customer's end customers: name, phone, email (when provided), conversation history, and booking data. Used solely to operate the virtual assistant the Customer has configured (answering questions, booking appointments, escalating to human support).

Sensitive data. If the Customer operates in a segment involving health data (e.g. clinics, pet care with veterinary history), the assistant may incidentally collect information classified as sensitive data under art. 5, II of the LGPD (e.g. reason for visit, symptoms). In these cases, it's the Customer's responsibility — not Zappigo's — to obtain specific, explicit consent from the data subject for that processing (art. 11, LGPD) before entering that information into the conversation with the assistant; Zappigo remains a processor, handling that data only to provide the service the Customer has configured.

Minors. Zappigo does not intentionally collect data from minors under 18 directly. When the Customer operates in a segment whose end customers may be minors (e.g. pediatric clinics), it's the Customer's responsibility to obtain a legal guardian's consent before providing the minor's data to the assistant, under art. 14 of the LGPD.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
sections.body:
For the Customer and its users, we process data based on performance of the service agreement entered into with Zappigo (Art. 7, V, LGPD), compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation (e.g. tax), legitimate interest for fraud prevention and service improvement, and consent where applicable.

For the Customer's end customers, the applicable legal basis is, as a rule, performance of the agreement between them and the Customer itself (e.g. booking a service) — not an agreement with Zappigo, consistent with the processor role described in section 2.

sections.title: 5. Data retention
sections.body: We keep data for as long as the account is active. After the account is closed (cancellation or termination), data is kept for up to 90 (ninety) days — during which the Customer may request the export provided for in the Terms of Use — and is then deleted or anonymized, except for an additional period required by legal obligation (e.g. tax, typically 5 years) or necessary to defend legal rights in proceedings.

sections.title: 6. Artificial intelligence: processing and limitations
sections.body: The virtual assistant processes conversation messages (and the catalog/FAQ registered by the Customer) through the Google Gemini API to generate responses. We use Gemini's paid API (billed usage, not the free tier) — under Gemini API's current Terms of Service, data sent via the paid API is not used by Google to train or improve its models, and is logged only for a limited period for abuse detection and prevention. We recommend checking Google's current terms directly for the most up-to-date detail on these guarantees. On the reliability of generated responses, see Terms of Use, section 8.

sections.title: 7. Recipients and processors
sections.body:
To operate the platform, we share data with the following service providers (subprocessors), each processing data only to the extent necessary for its function, under contractual confidentiality obligations:

  • Stripe — payment processing;
  • Google Gemini — natural language processing for the AI assistant;
  • Resend — sending transactional emails;
  • Meta / WhatsApp Cloud API — WhatsApp messaging;
  • Google Analytics — aggregated site usage metrics (see section 11).

International data transfer (Art. 33, LGPD). Google and Meta are companies headquartered in the United States, so data processed by these subprocessors may be transferred internationally, under the contractual and security guarantees offered by these providers.

sections.title: 8. Data subject rights
sections.body: Under Art. 18 of the LGPD, you (or the Customer's end customer) may request confirmation of the existence of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability, deletion of data, information about data sharing, and withdrawal of consent. Requests can be made to suporte@zappigo.com.br.

sections.title: 9. Security measures
sections.body: We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures — encryption in transit, access control, and isolation between different companies' accounts — to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. In the event of a security incident that could pose a relevant risk or harm to data subjects, we will notify the ANPD and affected data subjects within a reasonable period, under art. 48 of the LGPD.

sections.title: 10. Relationship with the Customer as processor
sections.body: The Terms of Use (section 6) already set out the Customer's obligations as controller of its own end customers' data, and the conditions under which Zappigo processes that data as a processor — we don't currently maintain a separate data processing agreement (DPA); this relationship is governed by the Terms of Use together with this Policy.

sections.title: 11. Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep your dashboard session authenticated and to remember your language preference. We also use Google Analytics (GA4) to understand, in aggregate, how the site is used (pages visited, traffic source) — we don't use advertising tracking cookies. Browsing data collected by Google Analytics is processed under Google's privacy policy.

sections.title: 12. Minors
sections.body: Zappigo is a B2B service, contracted by companies, and is not directed at minors. For data about a Customer's end customers who are minors and happen to chat with the assistant, see section 3.

sections.title: 13. Changes to this Policy
sections.body: We may update this Policy from time to time; the current version is always available on this page, with the last-updated date at the top. Material changes will be communicated with at least 30 days' advance notice, by registered email and/or notice on the dashboard.

sections.title: 14. Complaints and remedies
sections.body: If you believe your data wasn't handled correctly, contact us first at suporte@zappigo.com.br so we can resolve it directly. You also have the right to file a complaint with Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) — gov.br/anpd.
